findings.evidenceJa: ライダーをやり過ごせない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he cannot get past, evade, or weather Rider without Archer’s arm.
findings.explanation: The English changes the immediate escape problem into a general comparison of combat ability.

findings.highlight: I’ll project something and counter her
findings.evidenceJa: ゼロ秒で剣を作り上げ全力で迎撃する
findings.governingReading: He will complete a sword in zero seconds and meet her with full force.
findings.explanation: The English removes the zero-time constraint, replaces the sword with “something,” and drops the full-force counter.

findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの殺気が薄れていく
findings.explanation: The English again reduces immediate lethal intent to general hostility.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが健在であったのなら
findings.governingReading: Rider says Saber would have been Shirou’s partner had she remained alive, intact, or in fighting condition.
findings.explanation: The English reduces Saber’s lost viable condition to simple absence from the scene.

findings.evidenceJa: 振り返らずに屋敷から出た
findings.governingReading: Rider leaves the property without looking back.
findings.explanation: The English preserves departure but removes the gesture of deliberate finality.
